linked_process_id.description: Linked process identifier from eLabFTW (do not modify).

analysis_status.description: Status of the AKTA chromatogram analysis.

analysis_timestamp.description: Timestamp when results were committed to the database (UTC).

summary.description: Key metrics from AKTA chromatogram analysis.

num_peaks.description: Number of peaks detected in the UV trace.

files_processed.description: Number of data output files generated by the analysis script.

peaks.description: List of detected peaks with retention times and heights.

index.description: Index of the peak in the time-series array.

data_files.description: Output data file paths from the AKTA analysis script.

analysis_results_json.description: Path to the main analysis results JSON file.

timeseries_csv.description: Path to the exported AKTA time-series CSV file.

peaks_csv.description: Path to the exported detected peaks CSV file (if any).

plots.description: Plot file paths generated by the AKTA analysis script.

chromatogram_png.description: Path to the chromatogram PNG plot.

chromatogram_pdf.description: Path to the chromatogram PDF plot.

raw_analysis_payload.description: Raw analysis_results payload loaded from the analysis script's JSON output.
